reason: Provides image recognition for text-based DSH conversations by sending uploaded or local images to configured OpenAI-compatible vision models, with persistent history and multi-turn vision_ask follow-ups.

summaries.zh: 为文本模型提供图片识别能力，将上传或本地图片发送至配置的兼容 OpenAI 接口视觉模型，并支持多轮追问。
summaries.en: Adds image recognition to text-based conversations by sending uploaded or local images to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision model with support for multi-turn follow-up queries.

capabilities: Accepts pasted, dragged, imported, and locally referenced images for visual recognition
Sends image data to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision model endpoint
Stores images, recognition history, provider configuration, and API keys on local disk
Registers a vision_ask tool for multi-turn image follow-up queries
